What I can do and what I recommend:

- Once you have the statute text, you can paste the exact statutory language here (or summarize it) and provide a detailed description or screenshots of your checkout flow; I can then analyze whether the flow appears to implement the requirements reflected in that text. Note: because I can’t access the statute now, I won’t be able to fetch or verify any external material for you.
- For a binding legal determination or if you need certainty about compliance, consult a licensed California attorney.

If you paste the statute text and your checkout flow details here, I will analyze them against each other and point out any gaps based on the pasted statute.
